name: Library access policy
purpose: Separate book access inside Deen Allah Encyclopedia from offline redistribution rights.

referenceVault.principle: A restricted book may be retained for internal research/preservation only when a documented legal basis permits that retention; public GitHub must never contain a restricted full-text copy.
referenceVault.otherwise: Do not download or store the protected full text. Use an approved provider/official reader or a user-supplied lawful copy.

academicCitation.note: Quotation rights vary by jurisdiction and circumstance; the engine must not promise an unlimited quotation right or a fixed word-count safe harbor.

downloadUi.reference-only: Hide download controls; show reader, citation, copy-quote and source metadata controls subject to the source terms.
